title: NLC 2026 San Antonio — Competitive Event Schedule Released
body: The official 2026 FBLA National Leadership Conference competitive event schedule is now live at fbla.org/nlc. All competitors should log in to check their specific event time slots for June 29 – July 3. Mobile Application Development presentations are scheduled for July 1 beginning at 9:00 AM at the Henry B. González Convention Center. Make sure you arrive at least 15 minutes early for your assigned presentation room. Wear professional business attire for all competitive sessions.

title: Cherry Creek Sends 9 Members to NLC — Let's Go Falcons!
body: We are incredibly proud to announce that Cherry Creek FBLA District 12 is sending 9 members to the 2026 National Leadership Conference in San Antonio, Texas! This is our best national showing in chapter history. Competitors represent events including Mobile Application Development, Website Design, Business Communication, and Public Speaking. We have been grinding since District — let's show the nation what Colorado FBLA is made of. 🏆

title: New FBLA Membership Benefits for 2026–2027 Announced
body: FBLA National has announced an expanded benefits package for the 2026–2027 school year. Highlights include free access to LinkedIn Learning, a new partnership with Google Career Certificates, and expanded scholarship opportunities totaling over $2 million. Members who renew membership by September 1 are automatically enrolled in all new benefit programs. Check the Resources tab for the full announcement PDF from FBLA headquarters.

title: Mobile Application Development — What to Expect at NLC Finals
body: NLC Mobile App Dev is a completely different experience from State. Here is what to prepare for: Judges are national-level tech professionals with deep technical backgrounds — they WILL ask detailed architecture questions. The rubric weights UX and accessibility more heavily at nationals. You will have exactly 7 minutes plus 3 minutes of Q&A. Bring your device fully charged and have a backup demo video ready. Know every line of your code. Most importantly — show your passion for the product you built. Good luck to everyone competing tomorrow! 💪

title: NLC Block Party & Texas Rodeo Night — Don't Miss It
body: Two of the biggest NLC social events are this week in San Antonio! The NLC Block Party is tonight on the convention center plaza — live music, food trucks, and over 15,000 FBLA members from across the country. Thursday evening is Texas Rodeo Night — always a highlight of the NLC experience. Make sure your NLC badge is on you at all times for entry. Both events are included in your NLC registration. See you out there!

title: Leadership Workshops at NLC — Sign Up Through the Conference App
body: The 2026 NLC features over 40 leadership development workshops running throughout the conference. Session topics include: Entrepreneurship & Innovation, AI in Business, Career Networking, Public Speaking Mastery, and Financial Literacy. Workshops run Tuesday–Thursday at the Henry B. González Convention Center. Seats fill fast — sign up through the official FBLA NLC conference app or at the registration desk near the main entrance. Great for members not competing but still attending the conference.

title: Cherry Creek Chapter Wins Colorado FBLA Community Service Award
body: We are thrilled to announce that Cherry Creek HS District 12 has won the Colorado FBLA Community Service Award for 2026! Our 'Tech for Seniors' project — where members taught basic smartphone skills to residents at Sunrise Senior Living — logged over 400 volunteer hours and impacted 87 seniors. This award reflects the incredible dedication of every member who showed up on Saturday mornings. We are so proud of this chapter. 🎉

title: 2026–2027 Colorado FBLA State Officers Elected
body: Congratulations to the newly elected 2026–2027 Colorado FBLA State Officer team! Elections were held at the State Leadership Conference in April. Officers will be officially installed at the closing ceremony here at NLC in San Antonio on July 3. The new team has a strong vision for growing Colorado FBLA membership and competitive success in the upcoming year. Full officer list is now posted on the Colorado FBLA website and in the Resources tab.

title: San Antonio Travel Tips — Getting Around During NLC
body: A few travel tips for NLC week in San Antonio: The convention center is a short walk from the River Walk — great for dinner after competition days. Grab the free VIA bus shuttle running between official NLC hotels and the Henry B. González Convention Center. Bring comfortable shoes — you will walk 5+ miles per day on the convention floor. Pack professional attire for competition days and casual clothes for evening events. Weather this week is mid-90s and humid — stay hydrated and use sunscreen!

title: FBLA National Officer Candidate Voting Opens Tomorrow
body: Voting for FBLA National Officers opens tomorrow, July 1, during the NLC General Session at 10:00 AM. All registered NLC delegates are eligible to vote. This year there are 12 candidates running for 6 national officer positions including President, EVP, Secretary, Treasurer, Reporter, and Parliamentarian. Candidate speeches are this morning — watch for recaps in the FBLA app. Results will be announced at the closing ceremony on July 3. Check the FBLA NLC app for full candidate platforms.

title: How to Nail Your 7-Minute NLC Presentation
body: Seven minutes goes faster than you think. Here is the structure I used: 0:00–0:45 Intro (who you are, what the app does, why it matters). 0:45–1:30 Problem statement (the gap ConnectFBLA fills). 1:30–4:30 Demo walkthrough (show every rubric-scored feature — don't skip anything). 4:30–5:30 Architecture & code quality explanation. 5:30–6:15 UX design rationale and accessibility. 6:15–7:00 Conclusion with vision for the product. Practice OUT LOUD until it is automatic — judges notice the difference.

title: Colorado FBLA Partners with Denver Metro Chamber for Mentorship
body: Colorado FBLA has announced a new mentorship partnership with the Denver Metro Chamber of Commerce. Starting this fall, FBLA members can be matched with a professional mentor from over 200 local businesses. Mentors include executives from Lockheed Martin, Charles Schwab, DaVita, and Centura Health. This is an incredible opportunity to build real-world professional connections before heading to college. Sign up in the Colorado FBLA member portal — slots are limited.

title: 2027 NLC Announced — Columbus, Ohio
body: FBLA has officially announced that the 2027 National Leadership Conference will be held in Columbus, Ohio. Dates have not yet been set, but registration is expected to open in January 2027. If you are a freshman or sophomore, start building your competitive portfolio now — Columbus 2027 is your target. Resources for next year's competitive events are already available in the Resources tab. Let's get back-to-back national appearances! 🚀

title: Member Spotlight: Vedaant Pareek Advances to NLC in Mobile App Dev
body: We are proud to spotlight Vedaant Pareek from Cherry Creek HS for qualifying for the 2026 National Leadership Conference in Mobile Application Development! Vedaant placed 1st at State and earned his spot at NLC in San Antonio. He built ConnectFBLA — a full-featured React Native app that reimagines how FBLA members stay connected, featuring a live news feed, calendar, resources library, and complete group chat and direct messaging. Vedaant presents at NLC on July 1. We are all rooting for you! 🚀

title: NLC Opening Ceremony Recap — Welcome to San Antonio!
body: What an incredible Opening Ceremony last night at the Henry B. González Convention Center! Over 15,000 FBLA members from all 50 states, DC, Puerto Rico, and international chapters filled the arena. The keynote from entrepreneur and FBLA alumna Jasmine Carter was inspiring — her message: 'Lead now, don't wait for permission.' Flags were presented state by state, and the energy in the room was electric. Day 2 competitive events are underway today. Let's make Colorado proud! 🏆
